description: K-Electric Limited is a power utility that has been supplying Karachi for over 100 years, serving more than 3.7 million customers across a 6,500 square kilometre network spanning Karachi, Dhabeji and Gharo in Sindh and Uthal, Vinder and Bela in Balochistan. It describes itself as Pakistan's only vertically integrated power utility, managing generation, transmission and distribution across the whole energy value chain, with 2,397 MW of its own installed generation capacity supplemented by purchases from external producers and the National Grid. The utility was privatised in 2005.
headOffice: KE House, 39-B, Sunset Boulevard, Phase-II, Defence Housing Authority, Karachi, Pakistan

products.name: Electricity distribution
products.summary: Distribution of electricity to more than 3.7 million residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural customers across Karachi and parts of Sindh and Balochistan.

products.name: Power generation
products.summary: Generation from the company's own units, with an installed capacity of 2,397 MW, supplemented by 2,283 MW sourced from external producers including the National Grid.

products.name: Transmission
products.summary: Transmission of power across its network, including interconnection with the National Grid through the 500 kV KKI and 220 kV Dhabeji grids.
